name: Pale Rose Society: A Very Normal Fairy
source:
It's late at night and you are the local correspondent of the Pale Rose Society, a group dedicated to helping and advising people dealing with unusual problems of a magical nature.  Suddenly there is a tapping on your window and you are met by the most normal and not at all threatening looking fairy you have ever seen, who says she needs your help.  

[From [url=https://sidhe-ilustra.itch.io/pale-rose-society-a-very-normal-fairy]itch.io[/url]]
